with opencode on the PATH, setup runs:
  opencode mcp add --global factory -- maku mcp

otherwise: add this to ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (maku setup never edits a config):

{
  "mcp": {
    "servers": {
      "factory": {
        "type": "local",
        "command": ["maku", "mcp"],
        "codemode": false,
        "timeout": {"execution": 900000}
      }
    }
  }
}

setup installs the factory-handoff skill in ~/.agents/skills
and the /factory command (handoff, status, inbox) in ~/.config/opencode/commands
